results.content: # PhD @ UKM @ UPM @ USM | Many early-career researchers assume that publishing in high-impact journals requires extensive fieldwork, large research grants, and time-consuming a... Bibliometric analysis for early-career researchers. Summarized by AI from the post below. Many early-career researchers assume that publishing in high-impact journals requires extensive fieldwork, large research grants, and time-consuming analysis of full-text articles. With minimal resources—no need for data collection, participant recruitment, or even in-depth reading of each paper—bibliometric analysis offers a powerful, systematic approach to map research trends, identify influential works, and uncover knowledge gaps. Most importantly, when done rigorously, it holds strong potential for publication in Scopus- or WoS-indexed journals, including those in the Q1 tier. This is a reworded version of my original post from 26 October 2021 https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1RCg4Y5rxq/.
